premise: A baby not yet hatched lifts the top of the front egg like a lid, peeks out and ducks back in; Mama Triceratops plays peekaboo with it, and Ankylosaurus laughs till his club wags.
inspiration: The peekaboo game of the nursery, played by a baby who isn't even hatched yet.
lesson: Play is a way of saying hello.

en-US.title: Peekaboo Eggs
en-US.text: {eggs:enter} {triceratops:enter} {triceratops:go to eggs} Mama Triceratops sat by her nest of three eggs, waiting. {triceratops:face happy} Not yet. Not yet. Then, {sfx:creak} creak. The top of the front egg lifted up like a little lid, {eggs:live peek hold} and out peeked a baby Triceratops! Two round eyes looked this way, and that way. {triceratops:face surprised} [gasps] Mama blinked. {eggs:live peek resume} {sfx:pop} POP! Back in went the baby, and down came the lid. {triceratops:face happy} Mama laughed. "Oh, so it's a game!" {triceratops:live nuzzle hold} She tipped her big head down and closed her eyes. [playfully] "Where's my baby? Where can my baby be?" Creak. {eggs:live peek hold} Up went the lid. {triceratops:live nuzzle resume} "PEEKABOO!" said Mama. {eggs:live peek resume} And in went the baby again. {ankylosaurus:enter} Ankylosaurus came plodding by {ankylosaurus:go to eggs} to see what all the fun was about. {ankylosaurus:face surprised} Up went the lid, {eggs:live peek} and down went the lid. {ankylosaurus:face happy} Ankylosaurus laughed so much {ankylosaurus:live wag-club} his round club wagged and wagged. [happily] Not even hatched, and already the best at peekaboo in the whole valley.

es-ES.title: Cucú-tras en el nido
es-ES.text: {eggs:enter} {triceratops:enter} {triceratops:go to eggs} Mamá Triceratops esperaba junto a su nido de tres huevos. {triceratops:face happy} Todavía no. Todavía no. Y entonces, {sfx:creak} crec. La parte de arriba del huevo de delante se levantó como una tapita {eggs:live peek hold} ¡y por debajo asomó un bebé triceratops! Dos ojitos redondos miraron a un lado y al otro. {triceratops:face surprised} [gasps] Mamá parpadeó. {eggs:live peek resume} {sfx:pop} ¡PLOP! El bebé se metió dentro y la tapita bajó. {triceratops:face happy} Mamá se echó a reír. —¡Ah, que es un juego! {triceratops:live nuzzle hold} Agachó su cabezota y cerró los ojos. [playfully] —¿Dónde está mi bebé? ¿Dónde se habrá metido? Crec. {eggs:live peek hold} Subió la tapita. {triceratops:live nuzzle resume} —¡CUCÚ-TRAS! —dijo Mamá. {eggs:live peek resume} Y el bebé se escondió otra vez. {ankylosaurus:enter} Anquilosaurio pasaba por allí {ankylosaurus:go to eggs} y se acercó a curiosear. {ankylosaurus:face surprised} Arriba la tapita, {eggs:live peek} abajo la tapita. {ankylosaurus:face happy} Anquilosaurio se rio tanto que {ankylosaurus:live wag-club} la maza de su cola no paraba de menearse. [happily] Todavía sin salir del cascarón, y ya era el campeón del cucú-tras de todo el valle.
